name: Hosea Moffitt
bio: A Representative from New York; born in Killingly, Windham County, Conn., November 17, 1757; served in the Revolutionary War, ensign and later as lieutenant in the Fourth (Second Rensselaerwyck Battalion) Regiment, Albany County, N.Y., Militia; justice of the peace, 1791; town clerk, 1791 and 1797; member of the New York state assembly, 1794, 1795, 1797, 1798 and 1801; appointed brigadier general of militia March 22, 1806; supervisor of the town of Stephentown, N.Y., 1806-1809; sheriff of Rensselaer County, N.Y., 1810-1811; elected as a Federalist to the Thirteenth and succeeding Congress (March 4, 1813-March 3, 1817); member of the board of managers of the Rensselaer County Bible Society, 1815; died on August 31, 1825, in Stephentown, N.Y.; interment in Old Presbyterian Cemetery on ``Presbyterian Hill,'' at Garfield, in the town of Stephentown, N.Y.
